default_hardware_events.conclusion: Protocol extension default returns empty stream. A concrete scene can override; this default does not deliver native input.

handle_preferences_resolved.behavior: Lookup by seed; matching promise succeeds with supplied timing; remove seed entry afterward. Unknown seed does not create/cache a completion. Native callbacks/scheduling/reentrancy not observed.

resolve_handshake.duplicate_seed: Build error, remove prior pending seed, return Future.failed. Old promise deinit/cancellation/observer consequences unknown.
resolve_handshake.new_seed: Future.create then insert promise by seed and send scene message; fence cleanup/handshake lifecycle still unqualified
resolve_handshake.source_error_literal: can't resolve preferences twice for the same update

resolve_out_of_band.scope: Separate preference/fence action path observed in source; not executed; no GPU/fence completion claim

runtime_limit: Dlopen/resolution/own-memory observations only. No private Swift function invoked, event sent, native future created, Canvas workspace opened or Xcode attach performed.
